placebo_p_value: Use the plus-one estimator (1 + exceedances) / (1 + permutations); never report zero.
experiment_families: All diagnostics, parameter variants, universe variants, split variants and follow-up gates sharing an economic mechanism belong to one append-only family ledger.

multiple_testing.within_family: Use a preregistered max-statistic permutation across all registered variants, or Holm correction over valid p-values.
multiple_testing.across_families: Report false-discovery exposure and apply the preregistered FDR or family-wise policy; do not select the method after results are known.

validation_gates: Point-in-time and dataset capability gates pass.
Multiplicity-adjusted uncertainty excludes the null in the declared direction.
Net economics survive the declared cost range.
Results are not concentrated in one fold, sector, date cluster, or repeated security.
Effective sample size satisfies the preregistered minimum.

test_window.access: One recorded access per locked family/version after confirmation approval.
test_window.reuse: Any reuse creates a new exploratory family version and cannot remain confirmatory.

replication: Independent later period or independently reconstructed dataset using the locked specification.
production_eligibility: Requires TEST_CONFIRMED, REPLICATION_CONFIRMED, all data/terminal/cost capabilities PASS, and a separately approved portfolio implementation.
retroactive_rule: Existing Data test rows remain exploratory legacy evidence and are not retroactively preregistered.
